summary: Agroz Inc. filed a Form 6-K to provide notice of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for May 22, 2026, to vote on a capital reorganization: increasing authorized share capital from $11,500 to $102,000, creating two classes of ordinary shares (Class A and Class B), and authorizing a reverse share split in a range of 2:1 to 20:1. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is being announced; this is a routine corporate governance filing to amend the company's capital structure and articles of association. The filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
